I've been getting braces and having my rubber bands changed for almost a year now. I have to admit, I've never encountered a clinic that's this fast. Scaling is incredibly quick, sometimes finished in less than 10 minutes. The counter staff are great; the tall, thin one and the shorter one. However, I wasn't very impressed with some of the staff in the treatment rooms. They didn't seem very welcoming. I once called to inquire about prices and some information, and I don't know which staff member answered, but their tone was very harsh and unwilling to answer. Some words were muffled, and I couldn't hear them clearly. When I asked again, they replied, "I already told you it's like this and that..." Seriously??? Sometimes, you could just explain things politely without getting emotional. You're working at a private clinic where patients pay; it's a service job. You're not working at a government hospital where patients get free treatment. Please improve this aspect of your work.
